_source: Built mechanically from the facts of CBP ruling N354470 (2025-10-24, development Part 102 split; subject: "The country of origin of a receiver drier unit"). D570 rules on development data for the D590 error analysis. CBP held China. Components: the D362 materials; part codes: the top D381 development suggestion (unverified, D382); the good's code: CBP's (8421.29). Family: the family check (vehicle_parts, 0.85); name from the subject (D381 rule). Materials with no country left out (0: none). Groups: one model call with the production extractor's group rule (groups-dev-set.jsonl). Plants one per country; operations one per group and plant plus final assembly in Canada. Target Canada by the D171 rule counted mechanically; plant capabilities for Canada are an assumption. Economics illustrative. D590.
